target: RTX4090 exact19 B13 FP16 NHWC; S2 deployment with S1 attribution
strategy: split the AOT fused QKV+RoPE kernel into a plain AOT QKV kernel followed by the existing standalone fused QK RoPE kernel

ncu.sassMechanism: plain QKV preserves 64 HMMA per launch, removes 64 SIN, 64 COS, 192 FFMA and 256 FMUL, and reduces F2F from 128 to 64

naturalS2Nsys.mechanism: plain QKV falls to about 25.10 us, but the added RoPE is about 8.87 us and the launch gap raises the complete boundary to about 38.74 us under dual-stream contention

lockedS2Abba.contamination: reverse control A3 entered an anomalous 1491.570 nnEval/s phase; it is excluded from acceptance authority

decision: Retain and commit the exact-shape implementation default-off as a strict S1 intrinsic win and a reusable phase-control/plain-QKV test path. Do not enable it in the S2 deployment configuration. Reuse the clean Stage62 deployed full-graph checkpoint because deployed code and configuration are unchanged.
workflowLesson: independent NCU replay durations are not additive; complete cross-kernel boundaries require natural Nsys/NVTX or CUDA-event measurement
